description: This PHP source file defines the 'PgSQL' class within the Opencart system, providing an interface for connecting to and interacting with a PostgreSQL database, including connection setup, query execution, escaping strings, and retrieving metadata.

classes.name: PgSQL
classes.description: Class for managing PostgreSQL database connections and operations within the Opencart system.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new database connection with specified options, setting encoding and timezone.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Executes an SQL query and returns the result as an object with rows and count.

methods.name: escape
methods.description: Escapes a string for safe inclusion in SQL statements.

methods.name: countAffected
methods.description: Returns the number of rows affected by the last query.

methods.name: getLastId
methods.description: Retrieves the last inserted ID from a sequence.

methods.name: isConnected
methods.description: Checks if the database connection is active.

methods.name: __destruct
methods.description: Closes the database connection upon object destruction.
